text:
Aisha CSM: FYI Lumina renewal window 04/15. Procurement surfaced two items: their AP expects vendor master code LUM-900 but our quote uses RDW-GLOBAL. Also, they asked to attach vendor onboarding packet to the PO. renewal amt sits at $198,750 right now.
Tom RevOps: thanks. can you paste the quote/invoice metadata so I can check billing entity + invoice id?
Aisha CSM: sure — from the sales quote:
```
Quote ID: Q-2026-4471
Invoice target: INV-2026-1144
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Amount: $198,750
Listed vendor code: RDW-GLOBAL
Requested PO reference: LUM-BPO-2026-07
```
Evan (Lumina): Confirmed our vendor master has LUM-900. Procurement requires vendor onboarding doc and matching vendor code on the vendor master for invoices > $150k they will also route for additional approvals.
Marta Finance: Evan 94 can you upload the vendor onboarding PDF and the PO once it's created? We also need to know if your AP will accept our vendor name and just reference LUM-900 in the PO.
Evan (Lumina): I asked AP. Two paths: a) they accept Redwood Inference, Inc. as vendor name and put LUM-900 in PO reference field, or b) they insist we bill to LUM-900 and require vendor master change. Which is easier for you?
Priya Legal: from contract/legal POV we can change vendor code on invoice so long as billing entity and tax id stay the same. But finance needs written signoff that Lumina is authorizing alternate vendor code mapping. @Aisha please capture an email from Lumina approving whichever path they pick.
Tom RevOps: also flag: internal policy says invoices >= $200k require CFO wet signature on amendments. Right now we're under that threshold, but if Lumina adds 2 seats that could push us over. Let's plan for both.
Aisha CSM: good point. I'll ask sales to confirm final seat count now. If we end up >= $200k we should prepare wet-sign instructions.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123 - status: draft.
Evan (Lumina): Procurement uploaded LUM_vendor_onboarding_v2.pdf and created PO draft LUM-BPO-2026-07_DRAFT.pdf. They prefer option (a) to avoid vendor master churn. PO will reference LUM-900 in the reference field.
Marta Finance: perfect. we can accept a PO that references LUM-900 as long as vendor master name is Redwood Inference, Inc. We'll map the external code internally. Please have procurement include the onboarding PDF as an attachment to the final PO.
Priya Legal: action items: 1) Lumina to email approval that PO reference field is acceptable and that no vendor master change is required; 2) Aisha to capture that email and store it in the contract folder; 3) if invoice value >= $200k, confirm wet signature route or CFO email approval for e-sign.
Tom RevOps: timeline: renewal 04/15, we need signed PO + onboarding by 04/08 to hit billing cutoff. If seats change and we cross $200k, we need signed amendment by 04/05 to allow time for wet courier.
Aisha CSM: noted. I'll update here once sales confirms final qty.
Evan (Lumina): Sales just confirmed they might add 3 extra seats (est +$48k) but haven't signed yet. Procurement will still try to finalize PO this week. If seats land, they'll follow the wet-sign rule and route the amendment to CFO.
Aisha CSM: okay, contingency plan: 1) prepare two amendment PDFs (e-sign friendly and wet-sign printable), 2) pre-book courier pickup in case we cross threshold, 3) get explicit CFO email approval if they prefer e-sign to avoid courier.
Marta Finance: I can pre-authorize courier on our side but we need Lumina to confirm billing contact and mailing address for wet docs. Evan can you provide that?
Evan (Lumina): Will send billing contact + mailing address in a separate email and cc this thread.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope abc123 moved to 'sent' to Evan (Lumina) 2026-04-01 09:12 UTC.
Aisha CSM: summary checklist: [ ] final seat count confirmed, [x] vendor onboarding uploaded by Lumina, [x] PO draft created (LUM-BPO-2026-07_DRAFT.pdf), [ ] customer approval email about PO reference field, [ ] amendment signed (e-sign or wet). Will escalate to AM/Solutions Eng if not resolved by 04/08.
Tom RevOps: I'll monitor finance reconciliation and mark the invoice with a conditional note if amounts change.
Aisha CSM: thanks team. I'll drop the procurement approval email here when I get it. Keeping this thread as the single source for renewal execution.
Evan (Lumina): emailed procurement approval: "We accept 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as vendor master and will include LUM-900 in the PO reference field. Attached BPO pending final seat qty." (will attach PDF shortly).
